controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE source.ip == "172.18.0.16" AND @timestamp >= "2026-07-13T09:25:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-13T10:25:00.000Z"
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, host.ip, source.ip, message, event.outcome
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 20
